name: CM Internet
summary: Bunbury WA ISP run by Computers Mobile (cmi.net.au; national dialup + broadband + hosting, ~2004-07); retail site went static from 2007, domain redirect (parked) by 2012.

events.details: Dialup, broadband, hosting; earliest cmi.net.au capture Feb 2005.
Retail site content frozen (unchanged) from early 2007 through 2010; domain became a 301 redirect (parked) by Feb 2012.
source: Wayback CDX cmi.net.au: identical digest 5JJX4MR6... Jan 2007-2010, 301 redirect from 20120221

events.details: ABN 37 459 103 736 (business names 'Computers Mobile Bunbury', 'computers mobile'; sole trader Justin Ashley Reynolds, WA) was registered 15 Feb 2010 — after the ISP's ~2007 retail end; likely the same operator continuing but does not itself evidence the 2004-07 ISP.
